Hi Dana,

Thanks for asking about exports.

You can export any board as a CSV file. Open the board menu and select
**Export**. The file lists every card with its list, due date and labels.

Archived cards are not included. To export them too, restore them first from
**Settings > Archived boards**.

If anything in the export looks wrong, reply to this email with the board's
name and we'll take a look.

Best,
The Teamboard support team
